## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Hero Section— React Hooks for the Stellar Network

**Figma frame:** _Hero Section — React Hooks for the Stellar Network_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-01 (header navbar), UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-18 (buttons and states), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Main headline area introducing the product value, with primary/secondary CTA buttons and hero visuals.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Product headline, supporting copy, and primary/secondary CTA hierarchy.
- A hero visual that supports the Stellar and React Hooks message.
- Desktop and mobile composition with intentional content and visual order.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile hero frames with CTA and visual states.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Product value is immediately understandable from the headline and supporting copy
- [ ] Primary and secondary UI-18 button instances have clear hierarchy
- [ ] Hero visual supports, rather than competes with, the content
- [ ] Uses UI-17 tokens and UI-20 responsive layout rules
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
